# CarePoint Clinic

> CarePoint Clinic is a modern outpatient healthcare platform providing compassionate, human-centred clinical care, board-certified specialist consultations, on-site diagnostics, and seamless online appointment coordination.

## Overview
CarePoint Clinic connects patients with experienced physicians across primary care, cardiology, pediatrics, neurology, orthopedics, ophthalmology, and diagnostic imaging. We combine unhurried doctor consultations with digital scheduling, transparent self-pay and insurance pricing, and robust patient privacy protections.

## Core Capabilities
- **Direct Specialist Scheduling**: Book real-time clinical consultations and same-day telehealth appointments in under 60 seconds with instant booking confirmation.
- **Board-Certified Physicians**: Every clinician is fully licensed, credential-verified, and dedicated to empathetic care.
- **On-Site Diagnostics & Labs**: Rapid blood panels, high-resolution ultrasound, digital X-rays, and ECG testing.
- **Transparent Pricing**: Clear self-pay rates, verified insurance network support, and no surprise medical bills.
- **HIPAA & DPDP Compliance**: Complete 19-point security architecture featuring TLS 1.3 in-transit encryption, AES-256 rest encryption, and strict role-based access controls.
- **Zero AI Buzzwords or Synthetic Triage**: Real clinical care delivered by real medical doctors.

## Clinical Specialties Supported
- **Primary Care & Family Medicine**: Routine wellness exams, chronic illness management, immunizations, and preventive care.
- **Cardiovascular Health**: Echocardiography, hypertension management, cholesterol profiling, and stress test evaluations.
- **Pediatrics & Child Wellness**: Newborn checkups, developmental screenings, acute pediatric care, and adolescent health.
- **Neurology & Migraine Clinic**: Tension headache management, peripheral neuropathy diagnostics, and neurological assessments.
- **Orthopedics & Joint Care**: Musculoskeletal triage, joint injections, sports injury management, and physical therapy coordination.
- **Ophthalmology & Vision**: Comprehensive eye examinations, refraction assessment, and glaucoma screening.
- **Diagnostic Ultrasound & Labs**: On-site phlebotomy, thyroid imaging, abdominal sonograms, and rapid point-of-care testing.
